question: My laptop is not turning on. How do I fix it?
answer: To troubleshoot a laptop that won't power on: 1. **Check the Power Source:** Connect the original charger and check if the charging indicator LED turns on. Leave it charging for 15-20 minutes. 2. **Hard Power Reset:** Disconnect all external peripherals (USBs, mouse, external drives). Press and hold the **Power button for 20-30 seconds** continuously to drain residual flea power, then release and press once to turn on. 3. **Display Test:** If you hear fans or see keyboard backlights but the screen is dark, press **Win + Ctrl + Shift + B** to reset graphics drivers. 4. If the laptop still does not respond, bring it to TechStore (+91 9087086182) for free diagnostics under warranty.

question: My laptop screen is flickering. How do I solve it?
answer: To fix a flickering laptop screen: 1. **Restart your laptop** to clear temporary display buffer errors. 2. **Reset Graphics Drivers:** Press **Win + Ctrl + Shift + B** simultaneously; the screen will flicker once and beep as the display driver restarts. 3. **Check Refresh Rate:** Go to Windows Settings > Display > Advanced Display and ensure the refresh rate matches your panel (e.g., 60Hz or 120Hz). 4. **Update Display Drivers:** Open Device Manager > Display Adapters > Right-click Intel/NVIDIA/Snapdragon GPU and choose 'Update driver'. 5. **Hinge/Cable Check:** Gently tilt the laptop lid. If flickering changes with the angle, the internal display ribbon cable may need adjustment at TechStore service center.

question: How to turn my phone on?
answer: To turn on your Samsung Galaxy smartphone: 1. **Standard Power On:** Press and hold the **Side button / Power key** on the right edge of the phone for 3 to 5 seconds until the Samsung Galaxy logo appears on the screen, then release. 2. **If the phone does not power on:** Plug it into an official Samsung charger for at least 10 minutes to verify battery level. 3. **Force Restart:** If the phone is unresponsive, press and hold both the **Volume Down** and **Side / Power button** simultaneously for 10-15 seconds until the device reboots.

question: How to fix fast battery drain on phone or laptop?
answer: To optimize battery life: 1. Check Settings > Battery & Device Care > Battery to identify battery-hungry apps. 2. Enable Adaptive Battery and Dark Mode. 3. Lower screen brightness or set screen timeout to 30 seconds. 4. Turn off unused Location, Bluetooth, and Always-On Display when not in use. 5. Put rarely used background apps into Deep Sleep.

question: What should I do if Galaxy Buds audio is coming from only one side?
answer: 1. Place both earbuds into the charging case and ensure both charging pins make contact. 2. Charge the case for at least 15 minutes. 3. Open Galaxy Wearable app > Earbuds settings > Reset Earbuds. 4. Clean the earbud speaker mesh gently with a dry cotton swab.
